# ARKA Technovation Private Limited

> ARKA Technovation Private Limited is an enterprise technology engineering firm, digital growth agency, and corporate cinema studio headquartered in Sector 63, Noida (Delhi NCR), India. Guided by Founder & Managing Director Mr. Kranti Parashar (18+ years industry experience), ARKA operates dedicated 100% in-house specialist pods delivering mission-critical web applications, custom CRM & ERP platforms, search & AI answer engine authority (SEO, GEO, AEO), performance marketing media, broadcast-grade corporate films, and authoritative corporate journalism.

## Core Disciplines & Services

- [01 Software Development](https://arkatechnovation.com/services/development): Modular backend engineering, scalable ERP systems, custom CRMs with zero per-seat licensing fees, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), headless e-commerce, and bespoke enterprise software built on Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- [02 Digital Marketing](https://arkatechnovation.com/services/digital-marketing): Full-funnel performance marketing, multi-touch attribution telemetry, Google Search & Shopping Ads, Meta / Instagram conversion funnels, B2B Social Media Optimization (SMO), brand identity design token systems, and strategic PR management.
- [03 SEO, GEO & AEO Services](https://arkatechnovation.com/seo-lead-generation): Technical crawl architecture, Core Web Vitals speed engineering, structured Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for ChatGPT / Perplexity / Gemini, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for zero-click direct answers, and Google Local Business / Marketplace listings.
- [04 Film Production & Media](https://arkatechnovation.com/services/film-making): Turnkey cinematic corporate films, 4K/8K broadcast commercials, on-site industrial plant documentaries, acoustically treated studio podcasts in our Noida soundstage, executive interview podcasts, and next-generation generative AI video production.
- [05 Corporate World News](https://arkatechnovation.com/corporate-world-news): Authoritative corporate journalism, executive broadcast interviews, Tier-1 financial media wire syndication (AP-compliant), daily business intelligence updates, and empirical vertical market research.
